p.strong: Built by student geeks who wanna play games!

section.p: If you havent noticed, this website's style is heavily inspired by OpenBSD!
New here? Check out the about us page!
3L Enterprises started with a bunch of student geeks who wanted to play games during school, these geeks were desperate enough to start coding bypasses!
What does 3L mean? 3 Luna! Luna is our founder’s three-year-old cat, and now she has an entire project named after her!
Wanna help? Check out how to contribute.
by using our open source github repository, you can use something like bunny cdn to host our website unblocked for free! Another way to help is by giving out games and web proxies to us!
Yeah, like I even have a debit card!
